content.summary: Simulations Plus Inc. (NASDAQ:SLP) shares declined on Tuesday following the release of its third-quarter 2025 earnings report. The company reported sales of $20.4 million, representing a 10% year-over-year increase, but this fell short of the consensus estimate of $20.9 million. This miss followed preliminary third-quarter sales figures released in June, which were already lower than expectations at $19 million to $20 million, compared to a consensus of $22.78 million.
